description: This file defines a static internal class 'RuntimeContext' which manages the current grain context in an Orleans runtime, using thread-local storage to get, set, and reset the grain context.

classes.name: RuntimeContext
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing the current grain context within Orleans runtime environment.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Property to get the current grain context.

methods.name: SetExecutionContext
methods.description: Sets the current grain context and outputs the previous context.

methods.name: ResetExecutionContext
methods.description: Resets the grain context to a specified original context.
